• Diagnosis relies on multiphase contrast-enhanced CT/MRI showing arterial hyperenhancement + venous washout.

৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.question: ৩৮) Most common clinical feature of Cushing syndrome is:
৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.exp:
Explanation:

Central obesity is the most common clinical feature of Cushing syndrome due to abnormal fat redistribution caused by excess cortisol.

Cushing Syndrome
• Central obesity / weight gain → most common.
• Hypertension.
• Moon face.
• Proximal muscle weakness.
• Purple striae → highly suggestive.
• Easy bruising / thin skin.
• Hyperpigmentation → ACTH-dependent cases.

৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.question: ৩৯) The cardinal clinical feature of atopic dermatitis is—

Atopic Dermatitis

• Primary feature: Intense pruritus causing compulsive scratching and the itch–scratch cycle.
• Key findings: Excoriation, lichenification and xerosis.

Dermatological Features

• Atopic dermatitis → Intense pruritus + scratching + xerosis
• Intertrigo → Maceration of skin in moist folds
• Acute contact dermatitis → Erythema + swelling + vesicles
• Psoriasis → Silvery scales + Auspitz sign
• Scabies → Burrows + severe nocturnal itching
• Lichen planus → Violaceous polygonal papules + Wickham striae

৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.question: ৪০) Which cardiac biomarker is commonly used to detect heart failure?

• Released in response to ventricular wall stress
• Elevated in heart failure
• Used to support the diagnosis of heart failure

More About Cardiac Biomarkers

• Troponin I / T → Most specific marker of myocardial injury

• CK-MB → Useful for detecting recurrent MI

• Myoglobin → Early marker of myocardial injury; non-specific

৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.question: ৪১) The clinical features of pellagra include all of the following except—
৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.exp:
Explanation:

• Diarrhoea → Pellagra (Niacin/B3 deficiency)
• Dementia → Pellagra
• Dermatitis → Pellagra
• Diplopia → Not a typical feature

Key Clinical Features of Nutritional Deficiencies

• Vitamin A → Night blindness, xerophthalmia
• Vitamin B1 (Thiamine) → Beriberi, Wernicke encephalopathy
• Vitamin B2 (Riboflavin) → Angular cheilitis, glossitis
• Vitamin B3 (Niacin) → Pellagra: 3 D’s
• Vitamin B6 (Pyridoxine) → Peripheral neuropathy, sideroblastic anaemia
• Vitamin B12 → Megaloblastic anaemia + neurological features
• Vitamin C → Scurvy, bleeding gums
• Vitamin D → Rickets / osteomalacia
• Vitamin K → Bleeding tendency

৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.question: ৪২) Characteristic clinical marker of insulin resistance is:
৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.exp:
Explanation:

Acanthosis nigricans is a characteristic marker of insulin resistance and hyperinsulinaemia. Diabetic dermopathy, necrobiosis lipoidica and cheiroarthropathy may occur with both insulin deficiency and insulin resistance, so they are not specific markers of insulin resistance.

Acanthosis Nigricans
• Velvety, hyperpigmented thickening → neck and axillae.
• Strongly associated with insulin resistance, obesity and type 2 diabetes mellitus.
• Sudden, extensive, pruritic onset in an adult → consider underlying malignancy, especially gastric carcinoma.

৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.question: ৪৩) Hallmarks of haemolysis include the following, except—
৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.exp:
Explanation:

Hallmarks of active haemolysis:
• ↓ Haemoglobin
• ↑ Unconjugated bilirubin
• ↑ Lactate dehydrogenase (LDH)
• ↑ Reticulocytes
• ↑ Urinary urobilinogen

Intravascular haemolysis additionally causes:
• ↓ Haptoglobin

৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.question: ৪৪) Löffler syndrome is classically associated with—
৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.exp:
Explanation:

Löffler syndrome is a transient pulmonary eosinophilic syndrome caused by helminthic larval migration through the lungs, classically associated with Ascaris lumbricoides. It presents with mild respiratory symptoms, fleeting pulmonary infiltrates and eosinophilia.

Syndrome associations:
• Löffler syndrome → Ascaris lumbricoides
• Löfgren syndrome → Sarcoidosis
• Felty syndrome → Rheumatoid arthritis + splenomegaly + neutropenia
• Dressler syndrome → Post-myocardial infarction autoimmune pericarditis
• Reiter syndrome → Reactive arthritis

৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.question: ৪৫) Metabolic condition is not associated with severe diarrhoea -

• Severe diarrhoea → Loss of HCO₃⁻, K⁺ and Na⁺ in stool
• Result → Normal-anion-gap metabolic acidosis + hypokalaemia + hyponatraemia

• Autoimmune haemolytic anaemia

৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.exp:

৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.question: ৪৮) Which of the following presents as short stature, except—

৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.question: ৪৯) A parasitic infection causing nocturnal perianal itching is—

৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.question: ৫০) Which anti-tuberculous drug is associated with optic neuritis?

৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.question: ৫৫) Which of the following is a positive symptom of schizophrenia?

Thought broadcasting is a first-rank symptom of schizophrenia, in which the patient believes that their thoughts are accessible to others.
Schizophrenia — Clinical Features

Negative symptoms

৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.question: ৫৬) Which of the following is a cause of atrial fibrillation?
৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.exp:

৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.question: ৫৭) Characteristic lesion of seronegative spondyloarthritis is—
৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.exp:
Explanation:

Enthesitis is the characteristic lesion of seronegative spondyloarthritis.

Seronegative Spondyloarthritis
• Inflammatory arthritis characterized by negative rheumatoid factor (RF), with prominent axial and enthesis involvement.

Genetic association: HLA-B27

Serological markers:
• RF: Negative
• Anti-CCP: Usually negative

Examples: 
• R → Reactive arthritis
• A → Ankylosing spondylitis
• P → Psoriatic arthritis
• E → Enteropathic arthritis

Joint pattern:
• Asymmetric oligoarthritis
• Predominantly lower limbs
• Axial involvement: Sacroiliitis

Characteristic pathology:
• Enthesitis

Extra-articular manifestations:
• Acute anterior uveitis

৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.question: ৫৮) All of the following may be increased in clotting disorders except—
৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.exp:
Explanation

1. Prothrombin Time (PT)

• Assesses: Extrinsic + common coagulation pathways.
• Mainly reflects Factor VII.
• Prolonged in:
• Factor VII deficiency
• Vitamin K deficiency
• Liver disease
• Warfarin therapy

2. Activated Partial Thromboplastin Time (APTT)

• Assesses: Intrinsic + common coagulation pathways.
• Factors XII, XI, IX and VIII.
• Prolonged in:
• Haemophilia A → Factor VIII deficiency
• Haemophilia B → Factor IX deficiency
• Unfractionated heparin therapy

3. D-dimer

• Indicates: Breakdown of cross-linked fibrin after clot formation.
• Increased in:
• DIC
• Deep-vein thrombosis (DVT)
• Pulmonary embolism (PE)
• Other conditions with active coagulation and fibrinolysis

4. Bleeding Time

• Assesses: Platelet function and primary haemostasis.
• Prolonged in:
• Platelet function disorders
• Von Willebrand disease
• Thrombocytopenia
• Usually normal in:
• Isolated coagulation-factor deficiencies


* Remember *
• PT → Extrinsic → Factor VII → Warfarin
• APTT → Intrinsic → VIII, IX, XI, XII → Unfractionated heparin
• Bleeding time → Platelet function → prolonged in platelet disorders & von Willebrand disease
